map.黑棋先手，落子后在8个方向上夹住对方棋子的全部翻转为己方颜色。必须至少翻转一枚对: Black moves first. After placing, flip all opponent pieces sandwiched in any of the 8 directions to your color. You must flip at least one opponent piece to place. When no legal move exists, the turn passes automatically; when neither side can move, the game ends and the side with more pieces wins.

map.黑落 (3,3) 夹住白 (3,4)（右方为己方）→ 该白翻为黑，黑 +2、白: Black plays (3,3) and sandwiches white (3,4) (right side is its own) → that white flips to black, black +2, white −1; on a 64-cell board, if black 34 / white 30 at the end, black wins. Corners (the four corners) are the safest, edges next; grabbing corners early greatly reduces flip risk.
map.抢四角、逼对手少合法步；角稳定不被翻，是核心策略。: Grab the four corners and force your opponent into few legal moves; corners are stable and never flip—the core strategy.
map.64 格为偶，终局通常分出多寡；极少见完全均分。: 64 is even, so the end usually splits; a perfectly even split is extremely rare.
